note: Points an operator needs that the Graphene source does not define, found by the Phase 8 analyst agents (#85). A UPS says nothing of its battery: the rectifier-failure analyst could not tell it was carrying the load from battery. A chiller pump has no trip point, so a trip read the same as a lost run command. A power-quality meter raises no alarm when its voltage goes, so the incomers stayed quiet through a utility loss. The FCU's Flowrate (its chilled water) has no unit. Each new member follows the type's UDT and ADR-0003, and reads what the model already computes.
